_comment: Jodi voice agent - on_start lifecycle hook. Copy into Canvas > Tools > Add tool > API tool, set 'When should this tool run?' = on_start. Notation: '@X' = pick variable X with the @ picker in the dashboard; '{{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}}' = replace with the current ngrok https URL; '{{secrets.TOOL_SHARED_SECRET}}' = our placeholder for the workspace Secret (the dashboard takes it through a masked input, there is no documented template syntax). No real secrets in this file.
name: on_start_hook
description: Lifecycle hook (no LLM in the loop). Before the agent speaks, loads who is calling and why, and the mother's context, from the Jodi backend into the agent's input variables.
if_it_fails: No spoken text (lifecycle hooks have no LLM). The input variables keep their defaults (caller_role = unknown, call_purpose = inbound, language = kn), so the agent treats the caller as unknown and shares no history.

mock_response.focus_topics: bleeding, headache, stitches; baby feeding, jaundice (day 3-5)
mock_response.last_summary: Day 4: mild headache, baby feeding well.

notes: Contract: docs/contracts.md section 4.1 (+ section 8: additive next_call_day). Body fields are phone, interaction_id, direction.
Lifecycle hooks cannot use a response template (Sarvam docs, API tool page).

Outbound calls: @UserIdentifier may be empty. The backend sends call_direction=outbound, call_purpose, callee_phone, mother_id and language in Instant Outbound agent_variables, and binds the call by callee phone (or, with an empty phone, the single call it placed in the last 2 minutes). Still verify what @UserIdentifier contains on a real outbound call.
There is no call-context variable for call direction: 'direction' comes from the input variable call_direction (default 'inbound'), which the backend sets to 'outbound'.

If the mother was registered by family on Telegram and has not yet given her own consent, the backend returns call_purpose = onboarding for her first call, so the onboarding playbook asks her spoken consent.
Docs do not state the max wait for lifecycle hooks separately; we use the same 10 s as mid-call tools (API tools allow up to 30 s).
